messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — during the canary for the new embedding job we're hitting both GPU quota and pod IP exhaustion in us-west-2 EKS. Need infra to request quota bumps and a VPC secondary range increase before the 48h load test.

alex: Details: project=redwood-inference-prod, cluster=eks-west2-ml, nodepool name=gpu-pool-a, instance type=p4d.24xlarge (we planned 12 nodes => 96 GPUs). Current EC2 quota for p4d is 16 in region, so we need at least 32. Also running out of ENI ips when nodepool scales (CNI max pods per node ~58, but host ENI limit plus pod density causes exhaustion).

alex: TL;DR requests to make: 1) EC2 GPU quota (p4d family) -> 32; 2) VPC secondary range /20 on.eks-west2-subnet-2 (add extra secondary range); 3) Request ENI trunking / increase elastic network interfaces for the GPU instance family or request higher attachable ENIs per instance; 4) Raise EC2 classic quota for GPUs if needed.

maria: Is the /20 necessary? Can we shard nodepools into smaller CIDRs instead? :thinking_face:

alex: We tried ephemeral scaling with smaller pools, but the cluster autoscaler created many small nodes and we still hit ENI limits because each node needs a primary + secondary IPs for kube-proxy/ENI overhead. With p4d each instance gets very few ENIs. Secondary range on the subnet is the simplest short-term fix.

jordan: Can you paste the kubectl describe of one of the failed pods and the node allocatable? Might help the support ticket.

alex: pasted command output: ```kubectl describe pod gpu-batch-0 -n ml-jobs
Events:
  Type     Reason     Age   From               Message
  ----     ------     ----  ----               -------
  Warning  FailedCreate  2m   default-scheduler  Failed to create pod sandbox: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to assign an IP address: no available IP addresses
```

alex: node info: ```kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep gpu-pool-a
ip-10-0-5-123.us-west-2.compute.internal   Ready  <none>   58d   192.168.10.12   p4d.24xlarge```

leo: Ok. Sounds like two parallel asks to cloud support: GPU quota + VPC/secondary range. I'll open the request. Any preferred justification? Support asks for business case.

alex: Note that the full load test will be ~12m tokens/day and we want to validate autoscaling and batching economics. Put "production load test + capacity for 12-node p4d pool" as justification. Also add note about future plan to move some inference to cheaper g5 nodes but we need p4d for training/large evals.

maria: What about a short-term mitigation — can we spin a mixed nodepool with g5.12x for lower-priority jobs to free up p4d qps? Might reduce immediate need.

alex: Good call. I already queued the lower priority jobs to the low-priority queue but some evals still require p4d. We'll do a temporary node taint/toleration split.

cloud-ops: Opening AWS support case now. CaseId: 12345678901 (internal). Requesting EC2 GPU quota raise (p4 family) to 32, Increase network interface quota/ENI trunking on p4d.* instances, and addition of a /20 secondary CIDR to VPC vpc-0a1b2c3d in us-west-2. Including kubectl output and failure event.

cloud-ops: ETA from AWS is 48-72 hours for quota processing. I'll also request expedited review and note we have a scheduled load test.

jordan: Can you add a note asking for increased "IP addresses per ENI" for the instance family? Historically support routes that to ENI/trunking team.

cloud-ops: Added that to the ticket. Also attached a screenshot of the node scale-up timeline.

sre-bot: [alert] cluster/eks-west2-ml pod-ip-pressure HIGH — autoscaler paused due to ip exhaustion — 6 pods Pending.

leo: Thanks. I'll follow up with networking to ensure the secondary range change doesn't clash with on-prem VPN routes.

maria: Cost question — increasing p4d quota to 32 is expensive. Do we have budget guardrails for the load test?

alex: Finance already approved a one-off testing budget for this week. Confirmed with @finance. We should still try small optimizations (batching + cache) to keep hours minimal.

cloud-ops: AWS replied to case: initial review done, requested VPC and ENI specifics (subnet IDs + current secondary ranges). I provided: subnet-0f4a2b (eks-west2-subnet-2), current secondary used /24 blocks, requesting /20.

cloud-ops: Support marked as high priority due to scheduled production test. Will update when quotas are applied.

alex: Appreciate it — please post case id updates here. After quotas land we'll run the 48h canary and report perf/cost metrics. :thumbsup:
